notes.title: Let's Plays on School Bus Fun
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

I am proud to let you know that the game realyl got some attention. There are several Let's Plays about this game and there are more to come. The feedback on these LP was so great and the guys had so much fun they decided to do even more videos about it.

German LPs:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JBu3K3ILFTM
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kVNsVAxZA5w

English LPs:
coming soon

Have fun watching them!

Cheers,
Bodo
